name: SmoothPlayerAnimations
description: Smooth, highly-compatible player animations on a jointed model that bends at the elbows, knees and spine, driven by a data-driven animation graph that resource packs can extend, with procedural look and lean; a built-in CEM engine plays OptiFine / EMF player animation packs, and Better Combat and other animation mods blend in. | 流畅且高兼容的玩家动画模组：四肢与脊柱可弯曲的分段模型，由资源包可扩展的数据驱动动画图驱动，带视线跟随与身体倾斜等程序动画；内置 CEM 引擎播放 OptiFine / EMF 格式的玩家动画包，并与 Better Combat 等战斗/动画模组兼容。
